question: In a certain code language, 'PINK' is coded as '25', and 'HAIR' is coded as '18'. How will 'FAIL' be coded in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

**Logic : Half of the sum of positional values of the letters**

• 'PINK' is coded as '25'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5e02df79e18a088b00c9d491a06df9c42a973ec39f6d8524f0f4f33dba44a85.png] 

⇒ (16 + 9 + 14 + 11) ÷
